entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please state the reason for your call.
Yeah, hi. I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's not working properly, and I want my money back.
Thank you for contacting us. I understand you'd like to return your VeloBand Pulse. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase, please?
It's… uh… it's johnson.michael@email.com. Look, I don't have time for this. Just tell me where to send it back.

Thank you, Mr. Johnson. Let me pull up your order information. Okay, I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse on July 1st. Today is July 16th. According to our return window, VeloFit products have a 10-day return policy.
What?! Ten days? Seriously? I just got this thing! It's practically brand new. It's not working right! This is ridiculous. I want to speak to a manager!

I understand your frustration, Mr. Johnson. While our standard return policy is indeed 10 days, I can explore some options for you. A full refund isn't possible at this point given it's outside the return window. Let me check if there's a possible policy exception we can make.

After reviewing your account, I'm afraid a full refund is not possible as we are past the 10-day return window. However, I can offer you store credit for the full purchase price of the VeloBand Pulse. This would allow you to purchase another item from our website.
Store credit? That's it? That's all you can do? I really just wanted my money back. This VeloBand Pulse is garbage!

I apologize that the VeloBand Pulse didn't meet your expectations, Mr. Johnson. The store credit will allow you to explore other VeloFit products that might better suit your needs. Is that something you'd be interested in?
Ugh, fine. I guess store credit is better than nothing. How does that work? How long will it take?

Great. The store credit will be applied to your account associated with johnson.michael@email.com immediately. When you proceed to checkout on your next purchase, the credit will automatically be applied. You'll see it reflected in the order summary before you finalize the purchase.
Okay, I see. Thanks. I appreciate you at least doing something.
You're welcome, Mr. Johnson. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks again.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day!
